meta.framework: RED III / RED II style for transport fuels
notes: This file is intended to be a fuel-layer / RED-layer input focused primarily on WTT values and fuel properties.
Final TTW and WTW per km must be calculated in the vehicle/technology layer using consumption and combustion factors.
red_counted is a flag indicating whether combustion CO2 would be counted as zero under RED-style accounting.

fossil_diesel.red_annex_reference: Annex III energy content; FQD-style upstream value
notes: Uses the RED transport fossil comparator for reference.
WTT upstream value is the EU guidance value used for diesel under the Fuel Quality Directive approach.

hvo_uco.red_annex_reference: Annex III energy content for hydrotreated oil replacing diesel; Annex V pathway-specific values should be taken from certified/default RED pathway data
notes: Representative WTT placeholder for modelling.
Use certified RED actual/default values for the exact HVO production pathway.

hvo_animal_fat_cat1_2.display_name: HVO from animal fats (Cat. 1/2 rendering route)
hvo_animal_fat_cat1_2.red_annex_reference: Annex III energy content for hydrotreated oil replacing diesel; pathway must match RED Annex V rules for category 1/2 animal by-products
notes: Representative WTT placeholder for modelling.
Use certified RED actual/default values for the exact HVO pathway.

fossil_ng_cng.red_annex_reference: FQD-style upstream value; energy content should be filled from your chosen gas specification
notes: EU guidance gives 9.1 gCO2eq/MJ as the upstream part for CNG.

fossil_ng_lng.red_annex_reference: FQD-style upstream value; energy content should be filled from your chosen LNG specification
notes: EU guidance gives 15.0 gCO2eq/MJ as the upstream part for LNG.

biomethane_wet_manure_close_digestate_of.display_name: Biomethane from wet manure - close digestate - off-gas combustion
notes: Negative WTT can occur under RED accounting because default savings exceed 100%.

biomethane_wet_manure_close_digestate_no.display_name: Biomethane from wet manure - close digestate - no off-gas combustion
notes: Negative WTT can occur under RED accounting because default savings exceed 100%.

biomethane_biowaste_close_digestate_offg.display_name: Biomethane from biowaste - close digestate - off-gas combustion
notes: RED-based pathway value.

biomethane_maize_close_digestate_offgas.display_name: Biomethane from maize whole plant - close digestate - off-gas combustion
notes: RED-based pathway value.
No single RED Annex V/VI default WTT value is assigned here.
Use supplier- or pathway-specific certified upstream value.
Must be calculated from actual pathway data under the RFNBO delegated methodology.

renewable_electricity.red_annex_reference: Use actual certified electricity GHG intensity where available
notes: Use actual electricity mix / PPA / GO-based upstream intensity according to modelling choice.

grid_electricity.red_annex_reference: Use actual national or temporal grid intensity
notes: Do not use one EU-wide default unless that is an explicit modelling assumption.
